noAccessTitle: No access to the voice assistant panel
title: Voice assistant
hint: What the server knows about the cafe's voice kiosk: its role and logins, the retained dialogue log, and how far the setup has come. The assistant itself is a separate process — its guide lives in agent/README.md.

setup.title: Setup checklist
setup.userHow: Create one: npm run create-user -- cafe-kiosk "Cafe Kiosk (voice)" Kiosk
setup.agentStep: The agent process is configured and running
setup.agentHow: In agent/, copy .env.example to .env, then npm start -- --text. This process is invisible to the server, so this step stays manual.
setup.saleStep: A sale has been recorded by voice
setup.saleHow: Record one at the kiosk; it shows up here and in the audit log.
setup.footnote: The full guide — voices, models, hardware — is agent/README.md.

transcripts.title: Transcripts
transcripts.hint: The retained dialogue log: what the kiosk heard and what it answered, newest first. Audio itself is kept only for the few flagged turns.
transcripts.emptyDescription: No dialogue matches these filters yet.
transcripts.truncated: Showing the latest 100 turns — narrow the filters to see more.
